item.description:
VIDEO | Hyderabad: Telangana BJP chief N Ramchander Rao on the INDIA bloc's protest march to Supreme Court says, "Congress leader Rahul Gandhi and others have now lost their minds because they are frustrated at being out of power. They are trying to create anarchy out of that frustration. First, they attacked the Election Commission of India, a constitutional body. Then Rahul Gandhi made false claims about the President of India, saying she had agreed that there was a 'vote theft' issue. Now he is trying to attack the Supreme Court. How is the Supreme Court responsible for, or concerned with, your political agenda? It is an insult to the judiciary, the legal community and lawyers across the country. Congress is trying to create an atmosphere in which people lose faith in constitutional bodies. That is why the entire Congress party, out of frustration, is now trying to defame even the Supreme Court. The independence of the judiciary, an important pillar of our democracy, is now being questioned by Rahul Gandhi."
